name: Intel Xeon 6787P (Granite Rapids-SP, 86-core, 8-channel DDR5 host CPU)
memory_type: DDR5-6400 RDIMM, 8 channels (MRDIMM supported; ARK max speed 8000 MT/s)
memory_bandwidth_basis: DERIVED, not a printed Intel bandwidth. ARK lists 8 memory channels and DDR5-6400. 8 x 8 x 6.4 = 409.6 GB/s theoretical peak per socket at 1 DPC. The ARK memory-types line also mentions MRDIMM and a maximum speed of 8000 MT/s; that higher rate is not stored because the MLPerf Dell R770 row is explicitly 6400 MT/s (16x64GB).
notes: 86-core Granite Rapids-SP, 8 channels not 12. This is the cheaper socket (LGA 4710, 2S) and the one a reader comparing against a 12-channel Genoa should not conflate with 6980P.
